name: Amnesia - Diary Novel
source:
This is a short Kinetic Novel about my boring real life misadventures. It was made to help me remember my life in a interesting way. Yay. 

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/diarynovel.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
translation:
这是一部讲述我乏味现实生活中各种倒霉遭遇的短篇动态小说。制作它是为了帮助我用一种有趣的方式记住自己的人生。耶。

[来自 [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/diarynovel.shtml]Ren'Py 游戏列表[/url]]
